metric.why: Distributed AI training is unusually intolerant of network degradation; a lossy fabric shows up as wasted GPU-hours before it shows up as an outage.
metric.metric: Network latency, packet loss, and bandwidth
metric.definition: Continuous measurement of round-trip latency, loss rate, and utilization on the facility's internal fabric and external transit.

reading.body:
Network latency, packet loss, and bandwidth are measured continuously because distributed AI training wastes GPU-hours on a lossy fabric before any outage appears.

The metric belongs to uptime and redundancy, but its real cost is compute efficiency, not availability. A fabric can remain up while dropping enough packets to stall synchronized training runs, so the damage is silent and expensive. Sibling metrics track UPS battery health, generator runtime, and SLA uptime compliance. Those catch power and contractual failures, while this one catches network degradation that never triggers an outage alert.

The data does not specify thresholds, measurement points, or whether the fabric is internal or external transit, only that both are measured. It also does not say how much GPU time is lost at a given loss rate, so the metric signals a problem without quantifying the waste.

siblings.label: UPS battery health and generator runtime
